γέραιρεν: γεραίρω — honour, treat with honour; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐγέραιρεν)
δέρον: δέρω — flay, skin; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔδερον)
δεῦτ: δεῦτε — come here, hither; adv. used as a call to several, elided (δεῦτ’ = δεῦτε)
διέχευαν: διαχέω — pour apart, cut up (a carcass); aor. 3 pl.: ’they cut her apart’
διηνεκέεσσι: διηνεκής — continuous, unbroken, whole; neut. dat. pl., epic -έεσσι (= Attic -έσι), agreeing with νώτοισιν
δόρπον: δόρπον — evening meal, supper; neut. acc. sg.
δώομεν: δίδωμι — give; aor. subj. 1 pl., epic lengthened vowel (= Attic δῶμεν): ’we may give’
εἰπέμεν: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic εἰπεῖν)
εἰπέμεναι: εἶπον — say, tell; aor. inf., epic (= Attic εἰπεῖν)
εἶλαρ: εἶλαρ — defence, shelter, protection; neut. nom./acc. sg.
θεόφιν: θεός — god; dat./instr. pl., epic suffix -φι(ν) (θεόφιν = θεοῖς): ’to/by the gods’ (θεόφιν μήστωρ ἀτάλαντος ’a counselor the equal of the gods’)
κελεύετε: κελεύω — urge, bid, command; pres. 2 pl.
κολεῷ: κολεόν (κολεός) — sheath, scabbard (Attic κουλεός); dat. sg.: ’in the sheath’
μήστωρ: μήστωρ — counselor, adviser, one who devises; masc. nom. sg. (θεόφιν μήστωρ ἀτάλαντος ’a counselor the equal of the gods’)
μεθ: μετά (elided μεθ’ before a rough breathing) — among, with; prep. + dat. · also + acc., ’after, behind’ (μεθ’ ἡμιόνους ’behind the mules’) · also + acc., ’among’ (μεθ’ ὁμήλικας ’among his peers’) · also + acc., ’in quest of’ (μεθ’ ὕδωρ ’after water’)
νώτοισιν: νῶτον — back (of an animal or a person; a cut of meat); neut. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
πέρι: περί — around, about, exceedingly; adv. with anastrophe (accent thrown back): ’beyond all others’ (πέρι κέρδεα οἶδεν) · also preposition with anastrophe + acc., of place: ’around’ (ἄστυ πέρι ’around the city’) · also preposition with anastrophe + gen.: ’about, concerning’ (φόνου πέρι ’about slaughter’) · also preposition with anastrophe + gen., of the thing contested: ’over, for’ (ἀρετῆς πέρι ’over excellence’)
παῦσαι: παύω — make stop; mid. cease, leave off (+ gen.); aor. imper. mid. 2 sg.: ’cease!’ · also aor. inf. act., ’to make cease’: νῦν μὲν παῦσαι τόξον ’let the bow rest’
πείσομαι: πάσχω — suffer, experience; fut. 1 sg. (not of πείθω)
πεῖράν: πείρω — pierce, skewer; aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= ἔπειραν), accented before the enclitic τε
πινυτήν: πινυτή — understanding, discretion; fem. acc. sg. (noun beside adj. πινυτός)
πυρὴν: πυρή — funeral pyre; fem. acc. sg.
σπουδῆς: σπουδή — haste, effort, exertion; fem. gen. sg., after ἄτερ: ’without effort’
τάφρον: τάφρος — trench, ditch; fem. acc. sg.
τεθνᾶσι: θνῄσκω — die; perf. 3 pl. (= τεθνήκασι): ’are dead’
τοῦδε: ὅδε, ἥδε, τόδε — this; masc. gen. sg.: ’of this (man)’
ψυχαὶ: ψυχή — soul, spirit, ghost; fem. nom. pl.
ἀγορεύσω: ἀγορεύω — speak out, declare; fut. 1 sg.
ἀγῶνα: ἀγών — gathering, the place where people gather for the games; masc. acc. sg.
ἄκριτον: ἄκριτος — unending, ceaseless (literally ’undecided’); neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’endlessly’
ἄλλ: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. acc. sg., elided (ἄλλ’ = ἄλλο): ’another thing’ · also neut. nom./acc. pl. ἄλλα, elided, genuinely ambiguous with the sg. reading: ἄλλ’ ἐνόησεν ’devised other things’ or ’another thing’ · also the conjunction ἀλλά ’but’, elided, as printed before ἄγε: ἄλλ’ ἄγε δή ’but come now’
ἄρσενα: ἄρσην — male; neut. acc. pl., used substantivally: ’the males’ (Attic ἄρρην, ἄρρενα) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with βοῦν: ’a male (ox)’
ἅπαντα: ἅπας — all, the whole of; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. pl., subject or object of a verb: ’all things’ (τελευτηθῆναι ἅπαντα ’that all things were fulfilled’)
ἐθέλωσι: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing; pres. subj. 3 pl., in a conditional clause with κε: ’are willing’ · also pres. subj. 3 pl., in a general relative clause without κε: ’who are willing’ (οἵ τ’ … μνηστεύειν ἐθέλωσι)
ἐξαγαγόντες: ἐξάγω — lead out; 2nd aor. part. act. masc. nom. pl.: ’having led out’
ἐπισταμένως: ἐπισταμένως — skilfully, knowingly, expertly; adv. (from ἐπίσταμαι)
ἐϋφρονέων: εὐφρονέω (epic ἐϋφρονέω) — be well-minded, be well-disposed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., uncontracted (= Attic εὐφρονῶν): ’well-disposed’
ἕπον: ἕπω — be busy about, tend, dress (meat); impf. 3 pl., in tmesis with ἀμφί (= ἀμφέπον)
ἠοῖ: ἠώς — dawn; fem. dat. sg. ἠοῖ
ἠῶθεν: ἠώς — dawn; adv. ἠῶθεν, -θεν suffix ’from’: ’at dawn’
ἡμέτερον: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; neut. acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with κάματον: ’our (toil)’
ἤρχετο: ἄρχομαι — begin (+ gen.); impf. 3 sg., unaugmented: ’began (to speak)’ · also + gen.: ’led off’ (ἤρχετο μολπῆς ’led off the dance’)
ὁδὸς: ὁδός — way, journey; fem. nom. sg.
ὅμαδον: ὅμαδος — din, uproar of a crowd; masc. acc. sg.
ὅσσ: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος, double σ) — as much/many as; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσσ’ = ὅσσα): ’as much as’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject of a verb: ὅσσ’ ἐπὶ γαῖαν ἑρπετὰ γίγνονται ’as many creatures as come to be upon earth’
ὤλεσαν: ὄλλυμι — destroy, ruin; aor. 3 pl. act.
ῥέξομεν: ῥέζω — do, perform, offer (sacrifice); fut. 1 pl., epic: ’we will offer’
